original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.

Only changing helper terminal subspaces and monotone frames within the fixed scalar word, entrances and cleanup contract already covered by #1995/#2013.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: Narrowed to one helper-inventory lever of the staged544 T360 template (PR3734/PR3815): exact prices of hosted-width changes in the clock-free fixed-bin ideal. The deliverables are an exact dual over all 318,840 width-1..9 bin patterns with monotone, nonpositive helper prices; the theorem that free width reductions never raise the ideal ceiling 0.001730578437266246818741; exact width-unit prices with basis ranges; single-child staging bounds under the observed paid-rank identity; and the exact PR3682 -> staged544 decomposition. No new contract and no kappa.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a changed helper inventory. Staging (hosted-width reduction) is the engine of the pending gains in #3605 and #3734, and PR3815's open question 1 asks which changed T360 inventory raises the ceiling, so this package prices that lever exactly instead of proposing a contract. The task card's premise that a free width reduction is an upper relaxation of real staging was corrected during the work. All three pinned T360 profiles satisfy sum n_r r = 65088 T. Under that identity a literal staging unit must also remove one unit of local paid rank, so the package adds the single-child staging screen.
bottleneck_link: The complex primitive binds the selected conditional kappa. The staged-entrance family's gains (#3605, #3734) are ideal-packing gains of the complex local word. This package gives the exact price at which staging a helper pays in that ideal: (*) in README/PROOF. Expansion-gate point 4 (stage more helpers versus redirect to bins or the local word) can therefore be decided per candidate by one inequality.
stop_rule: Stop if the exact certificate fails and report the improving width move instead; ship without the decomposition if the PR3682 inventory is not pinned within 15 minutes; stop at the iteration deadline; stop and post nothing if a competing staged544 width or inventory pricing appears before submission.
evidence: verify.py (stdlib, about 6 s) prints PASS_STAGED544_WIDTH_LEVER_SCREEN. Ceiling bracket [0.001730578437266246818740, ...741]: F(a_lo) <= -1.31e-19 and F(a_hi) >= 5.28e-20. Dual feasible on 318,840 patterns with minimum reduced cost exactly 0, matched by a knapsack recursion. Prices monotone and nonpositive. Width-unit prices: 0.987736781185353068089966 (6..9), 1 (5->4), >= 0.991791369039984911721564 (4->3). Single-child staging gain bounds: 0.012263218814646931910033, 0 and 0.008208630960015088278435. Decomposition: width +8.889631030668177612809695088162, local -8.919009734220261337601597266358, interaction exactly 0. Paid-rank identity holds on 3 pinned profiles. Six negative controls fail as required. Second method: HiGHS (evidence/HIGHS.json) agrees to about 1e-11 in F and 1e-16 in roots.
